photos.llama_desc: A young girl in a white sweater, khaki pants, and white shoes with pink stripes, standing in a dimly lit room with a black wall behind her. She has long blonde hair and is wearing a white headband. She is looking directly at the camera with a neutral expression.
A small, long-haired dog in front of a window with white blinds. The dog is looking up and its fur is blowing in the wind. The dog is wearing a collar with a tag.

A man in a blue t-shirt with a white Disney logo and a red and white card on a table. He is holding a white cake with a red and white card on top and a lit candle with a red and white number 8 and a red and white number 4. The table has a red and white tablecloth with a red and white card on it.

A boy in a blue and white striped shirt holding a gift bag and a package of knitting needles. He is sitting on a wicker chair with a white wicker back and a brown cushion. The gift bag is green, yellow, and white, and the package of knitting needles is red and black.

A white refrigerator with a collection of magnets and a few pieces of paper on its door. A white envelope with a round metal seal is on top of a white paper with a black circle in the middle, which has the name "Tenni" written on it. A blue and a yellow business card are below the paper, with the blue one having the name "SRC" and the phone number "800-521-0398" and the yellow one having the name "Serene Comfort" and the phone number "248-765-1714".

A group of children and adults sitting on a floor, looking up at something. The children are all wearing winter clothing, including hats, coats, and scarves. The adults are also wearing winter clothing, and some are holding or holding onto the children.

Two men sitting on a stone wall overlooking a lake. The man on the left is wearing a white t-shirt with an American flag design and has a tattooed arm. He is smiling and has a pair of sunglasses on his head.

A baby in a white diaper sitting in a blue and white inflatable pool. The baby is smiling and has water on its face and body. The pool is surrounded by grass and a pink and white floatie is behind the baby.
